policies.measurement: Literal submitted-text lengths, separate from frozen Lean parser-token W_B
policies.characterPolicy: Python str length: Unicode code points, not UTF-16 code units or grapheme clusters; no Unicode normalization.
policies.whitespacePolicy: sourceNonWhitespaceCharacters counts code points for which Python str.isspace() is false.
policies.bytePolicy: Length of strict UTF-8 encoding of the exact stored/adapted text.
policies.linePolicy: len(text.splitlines()); Unicode line boundaries, no extra line for a trailing line terminator; unavailable when blank.
policies.contentPolicy: Retain comments, prose, invalid syntax and every other character; no heuristic extraction, repair or comment removal.
policies.emptyPolicy: Empty/whitespace-only submitted text has null source lengths; raw text counts may be zero. No zero-length proof is inferred.
policies.partialPolicy: Truncated text is adapted mechanically for length only, never evaluated here; explicitly partial and excluded by default downstream.
policies.unsupportedResponsePolicy: Refusal, malformed and unknown statuses fail closed; their text is not silently treated as a proof candidate.
policies.hashPolicy: rawResponseHash uses frozen canonical JSON digest; sourceTextSha256 hashes exact UTF-8 bytes, including blank text.
policies.fileBindingPolicy: When present, generation/manifest file SHA must equal exact frozen io.json_text serialization of the supplied object.

cloudCosts.computeBasis: Frozen official Azure retail hourly rates multiplied by allocation wall time through observed VM deallocation; six allocation intervals closed. This is a compute estimate, not an invoice.

closureEvidence.scope: Cloud cost display only. Original assembly/finalizer receipts describe the pre-closure page. An external immutable amendment receipt binds the final page and data.

operationalDisclosure.hardware_limitations: Same image and nominal per-proof limits; mixed physical CPU models. Wall-timeout outcomes may depend on host speed. This is not a controlled runtime-speed comparison.
